title: Repair task-owned governance progression validation

acceptance.text: A compact audit identifies each self-deadlocking rule and its safe replacement.
Regression tests cover authorized progress and all required fail-closed controls.
The manager separates immutable base provenance from accepted task progress.
Synthetic multi-commit acceptance proves authorized progression and rejects invalid drift.
The execution model documentation and focused governance suite pass.
Integration is attempted only after fresh destination owner-work checks.

risks: Do not weaken owner-drift, scope, CAS, or merge safeguards.
Do not modify closed scientific task records.
non_actions: No scientific data, temporal semantics, model code, training, GPU, or historical-task mutation.
Do not overwrite owner changes in the canonical main worktree.

steps.summary: Persist the design audit and write regression tests before the behavioral fix.
Implement explicit task-owned progression and permit lifecycle validation.
Run synthetic multi-commit acceptance, update documentation, and validate the release candidate.
Safely integrate only after destination owner-work checks and close the governed task.
